rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (25 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Black_Parade/Living_with_Ghosts, https://exclaim.ca/music/article/my_chemical_romance_detail_the_black_parade_deluxe_reissue. 10th Anniversary Edition of The Black Parade, released September 23, 2016 by Reprise (2CD / 3LP). Tracks 1-14 are the remastered original album (Disc 1); tracks 15-25 are the 'Living with Ghosts' bonus disc (Disc 2) of 11 previously unreleased demos and outtakes. 'The Five of Us Are Dying' is an early version of 'Welcome to the Black Parade'; no demo of 'Teenagers' was included. Not to be confused with the separate 2026 20th Anniversary Deluxe Edition, which has different bonus tracks.
